extras_joined_gr_gap_employer_dates_resu: {label}: employer, dates, a result or number
extras_joined_fit_runs_one: Runs 1 line onto page {pages}: cut or tighten
extras_joined_fit_runs_many: Runs {lines} lines onto page {pages}: cut or tighten
extras_fit_two_most: {pages} pages: two is the most, so cut or tighten to two
extras_dis_open_end: Your resume listed this as starting in {year} with no end date. Is this work still going on today, or did it end? Nothing was assumed for you.
extras_dis_two_current: This shows as ongoing at the same time as another role. If you hold both, that is worth saying plainly. If this one ended, it needs an end year.
extras_dis_gap: There is a gap before this role. You are not required to explain a gap you are not asked about, and the resume does not draw attention to it. Worth deciding now what you would say if someone asks.
extras_joined_dis_aging_msha46: This shows {year}, and MSHA Part 46 requires annual refresher training. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_msha48: This shows {year}, and MSHA Part 48 requires annual refresher training. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_flagger: This shows {year}, and flagger certification is typically renewed every few years. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_cpr: This shows {year}, and first aid and CPR certification typically lapse after two years. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_forklift: This shows {year}, and forklift operator certification is typically re-evaluated every three years. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_hazwoper: This shows {year}, and HAZWOPER requires annual refresher training. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_servsafe: This shows {year}, and food safety certification expires. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_joined_dis_aging_dotmed: This shows {year}, and a DOT medical card expires. Is it current? If it is, the year is fine to leave off. If it lapsed, it should come off the resume rather than go to an employer as a current credential.
extras_dis_unsupported: This says something about you that you did not tell us, so we cannot stand behind it and neither should you. If it is true, say it in your own words and it stays. If it is not, take it out. An employer asking about it in an interview is the worst way to find out.
extras_dis_contradicts: This says the opposite of what you told us. Whatever the truth is, it has to be yours. Take this out or rewrite it in your own words.
extras_dis_vague: This line tells an employer the job existed, not what you did in it. What is one specific thing you handled here? If you know a number for this, add it. If not, the line stands without one.
extras_dis_first_person: Resume bullets normally drop "I" and "my". This one kept them, which reads as copied rather than written. Want it rephrased?
extras_dis_no_numbers: No line on this resume carries a number. That is fine when every line is true. If you know a number for this, add it. If not, the line stands without one.
extras_cr_facility_ask_q: Does this name the place you chose to leave off?
extras_cr_facility_ask_why: It shares a word with a place you keep off this lane. Until you answer, the page stays a draft. If it's that place, it comes off the page. If not, it stays, and you won't be asked about it again.
extras_cr_facility_ask_held_why: It has part of the name of a place you keep off this lane, so it's off the page until you answer. If it's that place, it stays off. If not, it goes back on, and you won't be asked about it again.
extras_cr_work_title_names_facility_q: This work's title names a facility. On this lane, do you want the true title, or leave it off?
extras_cr_entry_names_facility_q: This one names a facility. On this lane, do you want the true title, a line with just the venue, or leave it off?
extras_cr_stays_off_until_pick: It stays off this lane until you pick. A softened or renamed title is never used.
extras_cr_looks_like_facility_q: Does this title or place name a prison, jail or other facility? If it does, mark it so you choose how it shows.
extras_cr_you_decide_facility: You decide, lane by lane, whether a facility is named on the page.
extras_cr_degree_q: Is this a degree a college conferred on you? A certificate or coursework is not a degree. Say which it is.
extras_cr_degree_why: Degrees get checked. The page has to name exactly what you hold.
extras_cr_expected_q: When do you expect to finish? A year is enough.
extras_cr_expected_why: Study in progress shows when it is expected, in your words.
extras_cr_instructor_q: Was that your exact title on paper? Were you the instructor of record?
extras_cr_instructor_why: Teaching titles are listed exactly as held. A program role never reads as faculty.
extras_cr_commission_q: Did someone commission this and pay for it? If not, it can go in as a work or a project instead.
extras_cr_commission_why: "Commissioned" means someone asked for it and paid.
extras_cr_collection_q: Does a public place hold it, or a private person?
extras_cr_collection_why: Public collections are listed first. A private collector is named only with their OK.
extras_cr_quote_q: Where did this quote run, and on what date?
extras_cr_quote_why: A quote is used only with its outlet and date, word for word.
extras_cr_proof_q: You marked this one as still finding the proof. Have you found it?
extras_cr_proof_why: Anything you send can be checked. Know where the proof is first.
extras_cr_top_kept_off_q: What you typed for the top of the page names something you chose to keep off this lane. It's kept off. Change it, or change that choice?
extras_joined_cr_field_name_why: Field: your name. Your choices apply to every line on this lane.
extras_joined_cr_field_based_why: Field: where you're based. Your choices apply to every line on this lane.
extras_cr_line_kept_off_q: A line in your record names something you chose to keep off this lane. It's kept off the page. Change it, or change that choice?
extras_cr_line_kept_off_why: Your choices about work that names a facility apply to every line on this lane.
extras_cr_name_q: What name do you want at the top?
extras_cr_name_why: The page needs your name, written the way you use it.
extras_cr_contact_q: How should people reach you: email, phone or a website?
extras_cr_contact_why: A curator or panel needs a real way to reach you.
extras_cr_empty_q: What's one show, program, award or work to start with? Add it to your record.
extras_cr_empty_why: There's nothing on the page yet.
extras_cr_not_in_record_q: This line isn't in your record. Is it yours? If so, add it to your record first.
extras_cr_not_in_record_why: Every line on the page comes from your record.
extras_cr_year_why: Every entry on an artist resume carries its year.
extras_cr_record_says_q: Your record says {years}. Which is right?
extras_cr_years_why: Years are never moved on the page.
extras_cr_sits_under_q: This sits under "{heading}", but your record lists it differently. Which is right?
extras_cr_sits_under_why: A group show never reads as solo; a reading never as a performance.
extras_cr_title_mode_q: On this lane, do you want the true title, a line with just the venue, or leave it off?
extras_cr_title_mode_why: A title that names a facility shows only the way you chose.
extras_joined_cr_was_it_juried: Was it juried? Your record doesn't say so.
extras_joined_cr_was_it_invitational: Was it invitational? Your record doesn't say so.
extras_joined_cr_was_it_curated_by: Was it curated by? Your record doesn't say so.
extras_joined_cr_was_it_touring: Was it touring? Your record doesn't say so.
extras_cr_upgrade_why: Those words go on only when you said them.
extras_cr_line_mismatch_q: This line doesn't match your record. Which version is true?
extras_cr_line_mismatch_why: Title, venue, place and status come from your record, word for word.
extras_cr_pages_4_q: It runs past 4 pages. Which entries are your strongest? Pick those as Selected.
extras_cr_pages_2_q: It runs past 2 pages. Pick your strongest entries as Selected, or turn on more pages if the call allows it.
extras_cr_pages_why: An artist resume is 1 to 2 pages, up to 4 only when a call allows it. Never shrunk, never padded.
extras_joined_cr_waiting_one: {waiting} drafted sentence is waiting for your OK. Keep or cut each one?
extras_joined_cr_waiting_many: {waiting} drafted sentences are waiting for your OK. Keep or cut each one?
extras_cr_waiting_why: Only sentences you keep go in your bio.
extras_cr_sentence_kept_off_q: This sentence names something you chose to keep off this lane. Cut it, or change that choice?
extras_cr_sentence_kept_off_why: Your choices about work that names a facility apply to every page on this lane.
extras_cr_record_changed_q: This sentence came from your record, and your record changed. Review it on screen: keep it in your own words, or cut it?
extras_cr_record_changed_why: A drafted sentence can only say what your record says today.
extras_cr_untraced_q: Where does "{word}" come from? It isn't in your record. Add it there, or say it another way.
extras_cr_untraced_why: Panels check what a bio names. Your record is where the proof lives.
extras_cr_unbacked_q: "{word}": does your record back that? Your record lists it differently. Say it the way the record does, or add it there.
extras_cr_unbacked_why: A show, award or program is described the way it really was. Panels check.
extras_cr_count_q: "{word}": what's the real count? Put in the number you can back up, or cut it.
extras_cr_count_why: Numbers come from you and have to hold up.
extras_cr_third_person_q: A bio is written about you (she, he, they, or your name). Want to put this sentence that way?
extras_cr_third_person_why: Bios are third person. Your statement is where you say I.
extras_cr_statement_words_q: "{word}" is about what the work means. Does this belong in your statement instead?
extras_cr_statement_words_why: The bio lists facts. The statement says what the work is about.
extras_cr_puff_q: What backs up "{word}"? If nothing in your record does, cut the word.
extras_cr_puff_why: Praise words read as claims. A panel looks for the facts behind them.
extras_joined_cr_over_chars_q: This runs over {words} words or {chars} characters. Which sentence can go?
extras_joined_cr_over_words_q: This runs over {words} words. Which sentence can go?
extras_cr_over_why: Applications cut off anything past their limit.
extras_cr_statement_model_q: Part of this matches words a model wrote. Can you put that part in your own words?
extras_cr_statement_model_why: Your statement is yours. The tool never writes it.
extras_cr_work_kept_off_q: A work's title or description names something you chose to keep off this lane. It's kept off the list. Change it, or change that choice?
extras_cr_work_not_in_record_q: This work isn't in your record. Add it there first?
extras_cr_work_not_in_record_why: Every sample comes from your record.
extras_cr_work_off_list_q: This work's title names a facility, and this lane keeps it off. Take it off the list, or change that choice?
extras_cr_work_mismatch_q: This doesn't match how you described the work. Which version is yours?
extras_cr_work_mismatch_why: Title, year, medium, size and description are copied from your words.
extras_cr_medium_q: What is it made of, and how big or how long is it?
extras_cr_medium_why: Panels look for medium and size on every sample.
extras_cr_line_not_in_record: A line that is not in your record

extras_proactive_follow_up_due: It is time to follow up with {company}. Around five days out is the sweet spot. Want me to help you draft the message?
extras_proactive_tailor_resume: You saved {jobTitle} at {company}. The thing that gets callbacks is tailoring your resume to that posting. Want to start it?
extras_proactive_disclosure: Your resume is tailored. Before you apply, let's plan how you talk about your background. It is strategy and timing, not confession.
extras_joined_proactive_practice_one: You practiced 1 time this week. That repetition is what changes how you answer under pressure. Want to debrief your last session?
extras_joined_proactive_practice_many: You practiced {n} times this week. That repetition is what changes how you answer under pressure. Want to debrief your last session?
